svg.title: Zhaohui Li — publication landscape
svg.desc: A venue-by-topic matrix. Colors show venue communities. Numbers count works; a work may be tagged with several topics. The figure includes papers, a poster, datasets, and a preprint, not citation counts.
svg.text: 23 works · 17 venues and repositories · 7 overlapping research themes
Read across a venue for its themes; read down a theme to see connections across communities.
Each number counts works, not citations. Circle size is constant; topic counts overlap and should not be added.
Colors are curated venue groupings, not exclusive disciplines. Gray denotes repositories for datasets and preprints.
zhaohuilee.com/publications · Source: current academic CV and publication records
